title: sanguisorba minor subsp. dictyocarpa
intro: Sanguisorba minor subsp. dictyocarpa, commonly known as Dotted Burnet, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, known for its distinctive red flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in treating wounds, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Sanguisorba minor subsp. dictyocarpa include astringency, hemostasis, and anti-inflammatory effects, which make it useful in treating various conditions such as diarrhea, dysentery, and hemorrhage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
